partial_note: fire years whose window extends past 31 Dec 2025, or begins before the series has data (raw 2001-01-01, harmonized 2002-07-04), are listed in 'partial' with null values for that series and are excluded from trends
trend_note: Descriptive OLS of the day (onset 10%, midpoint 50%, end 90%) on fire year over usable years (non-null, not partial), in days/decade. se_per_decade is the usual OLS slope standard error; ci95 is slope +/- t(0.975, n-2) * se. These assume independent, homoscedastic residuals and a linear trend, none of which has been tested: treat them as descriptive. Endpoint sensitivity: the slope recomputed after dropping the first 3 usable years (drop_first3) and, separately, the last 3 usable years (drop_last3), each only if at least 8 usable years remain (else null); sensitivity_range is the min and max of the full, drop_first3 and drop_last3 slopes. approximate = true for countries at monthly resolution, whose days are interpolated within months, not observed.
resolution_note: daily: from point detections; monthly: from the monthly calendars, assuming detections spread evenly within each month (an estimate at monthly resolution)

monthly_vs_daily.definition: monthly-method minus daily-method trend (days/decade) for onset, peak and end, over countries with both
